decisions.decision: Use versioned JSON and append-only JSONL under the existing Picture Dictionary path
decisions.reason: Static hosting supports stable unauthenticated machine-readable public evidence

decisions.decision: Private repository holds restricted operational evidence until authenticated site access is verified
decisions.reason: No existing Glen or access-control implementation was found in the current repository or live homepage

decisions.decision: Feature-gate durable jobs; preserve existing paths until staging validation
decisions.reason: Production configuration and compatibility must be checked before activation

decisions.decision: Use a separate narrowly routed Worker for public records and protected records beneath the existing Glen host
decisions.reason: Glen was verified as a separate Worker system. Reuse the current signed owner login boundary without changing Glen business code or widening reader/service access.

decisions.decision: Run provider-free full-chain/fault acceptance through real private cloud infrastructure with fixture providers and a separate PostgreSQL schema/queue/service
decisions.reason: Avoid exercising synthetic faults against the real vocabulary or credentials. Keep test-adapter failures distinct from production defects; commit outbox with the outer transaction across explicit flushes and savepoints.
